name: ponchik_bench_barbell_c
prompt: Game sprite sheet: 8 animation frames of ONE smooth bench-press push from the lowest point up to the top, in a grid of 2 rows x 4 columns, read left to right, top row first, generous empty space between frames, never mirror a frame. Character: the fat black-and-white tomcat Ponchik, EXACTLY as in the FIRST reference (colours, round body, short legs, head size, line weight). Pose and camera angle as in the SECOND reference: lying on his back on an invisible bench, head at the top right, legs bent and down to the floor. Both front paws grip a BARBELL exactly like the THIRD reference (a wooden stick with two bundles of tin cans tied with rope at its ends), the barbell always horizontal, the same size in every frame and FULLY visible in every frame (both ends inside the frame with empty space around them), the fists hold the stick between the can bundles, about shoulder width apart, always at the same height as each other. Frames: 1) the lowest point: the barbell just above the chest, the elbows bent and dropped beside the body; 2-7) the bar is pushed up in small, EVEN steps; 8) the top: the arms extended up but the elbows still a little bent. The arms keep their natural length (short chubby arms, never stretched). VERY IMPORTANT: the head, body, belly, legs and feet stay EXACTLY in the same place, size and angle in all 8 frames, only the arms and the barbell move. The SAME grumpy facial expression in all 8 frames (as in the references, no blinking, no change of expression), the barbell never covers the face. Comic book style exactly like the references. IMPORTANT: no bench, no floor line. IMPORTANT: the background of the whole sheet MUST be solid flat pure chroma-key GREEN (#00FF00) everywhere, no black areas, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no frame numbers. Do not use green on the character.
